author: Life of Boris
description:
I went back to programming school after 5+ years away from tech. By day three we were on bit sets, I was falling behind, and then I saw what my classmates were really doing: one big AI window, "do this for me please", enter.

AI won. We lost. In this video I talk about what studying programming actually looks like in 2026, why nobody tells you that you're expected to use AI, how I went from falling behind to the top of my class, and what tech companies really hire you for (spoiler: it's not the languages on your CV).

Next video: how to actually use AI to learn things that matter.
